maddeler.e:
أستقرأ (form X)
# أُسْتَقْرَأُ (ʔustaqraʔu) /ʔus.taq.ra.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# أُسْتَقْرَأَ (ʔustaqraʔa) /ʔus.taq.ra.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# أُسْتَقْرَأْ (ʔustaqraʔ) /ʔus.taq.raʔ/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
